name: Azeroth Companion
title: Device Reliability — Mobile & Desktop Experience Audit
features: Fixed the Quick Deck editor losing keyboard focus after toggling a favorite and prevented stale shortcuts from consuming its six-button limit.
Fixed grouped mobile tool-search visibility when reopening the All Tools drawer and when resizing from phone to desktop widths.
Added real automated browser interaction audits in desktop Chromium and phone-sized Chromium/WebKit, including responsive overflow, JavaScript exceptions, update center, navigation and preferences.
Added GitHub Actions device testing on pull requests and main-branch releases, with failure screenshots to support troubleshooting without requiring local Node.
Published a practical physical iPhone Safari and desktop acceptance checklist to distinguish browser emulation from real-device testing.
Preserved the v4.5 Sovereign Portal, v4.4 appearance controls, all character/item studios, Cloudflare Worker and existing browser-local planning data.
Added source-level regression protections for site-shell isolation, keyboard focus, responsive transitions and non-sensitive browser tests.
